messages:
maria (sre): FYI incident channel didn't escalate to pager for ~15m. customer-facing error spikes in notify-prod. triage-bot shows repeated backoff. investigating.

triage (incident-bot): [system] entering exponential backoff after 5 failed send attempts. last_error: 502 from pager-proxy.gateway

luke (oncall): i didn't get any page. no SMS, no phone. checked PagerDuty — nothing. :confused:

jin (eng-infra): looking at notify-queue and dlq. redis list len is 0, dlq length 42. signs of auth failures, see repeated 401/502 to pager-proxy in logs.

maria (sre): manually paging now (emergency route). @luke — sending SMS+call.

ops-bot: manual page sent to +1-555-0123 via sms-route (id: sms-834). delivery_status: delivered.

luke (oncall): got the manual page. responding. :thumbsup:

jin (eng-infra): tailing signing-service logs: `2026-02-12T14:12:01Z ERROR signing-service outgoing 502 Bad Gateway` then `token refresh job failed: 5xx`. curl probe: ```curl -v https://pager-proxy.internal/send -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAGER_KEY'``` shows intermittent 401/502.

maria (sre): initial hypothesis: recent deploy to signing-service introduced regression in token exchange with pager-proxy; causes incident-bot to backoff and stop paging. customer impact estimated for alerts between 14:00-14:15 UTC.

triage (incident-bot): detected manual reset action by jin; resuming send attempts.

jin (eng-infra): rolling back signing-service to previous revision now: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/signing-service -n notify`

ops-bot: pinned runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging-integration (runbook v1.4).

luke (oncall): test send after rollback succeeded, i received test page and followup.

maria (sre): customer impact: approx 5-12% of pages queued between 14:00-14:15 didn't reach oncall; CS notified for a handful of enterprise customers. mitigation: rollback + queue drain.

jin (eng-infra): draining dlq now: `notify-dlq -> resend` (progress: 42/42 queued). monitoring delivery.

maria (sre): closing live mitigation. will create retro + postmortem with timeline and action items (add additional alerting on incident-bot backoff and token-refresh failures). thanks all :heart:

luke (oncall): thx, recommend adding a tiny-handoff step: if bot backoff hits threshold, auto-failover to emergency manual route. :eyes:

maria (sre): noted. adding to postmortem action items.
